general.\"Career one\" aims to provide h: CAREER ONE – Your free career guide. From dreams to careers, we have got the tools to get you there.
general.Career One is a Sri Lankan platf:
CAREER ONE is the national career guidance platform of Sri Lanka’s Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) sector. It is designed to bridge the gap between skilled youth and industry demand, while digitising career guidance services. This provides a faster and simpler way to plan your vocational career path, search for a desired job, and build a strong future.
Developed under the TVET Career Platform Project funded by a grant from the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) to Sri Lanka, CAREER ONE empowers NVQ Trainees, NVQ certificate holders, Career Guidance Officers, and organisations in the public and private sectors through a centralised digital ecosystem. By aligning vocational education with industry needs, CAREER ONE contributes to enhancing decent employment for Sri Lankan youth.

Career One is a Sri Lankan platform that provides comprehensive solutions to Sri Lankan career seekers.
                    The “TVET Career Platform Project in Sri Lanka“ aims to use the Sri Lanka ICT-based Career Platform to provide high-quality career guidance for trainees with high-level vocational skills throughout Sri Lanka. Project objectives is providing quality career development guidance for vocational skills education trainees and Improving employment of graduates of vocational skills  education and training in Sri Lanka.
